  "summary": "These four pages are the typed minutes of the All India Swatantra Party’s National Executive Committee meeting held on 9 April 1975 at the Local Library Authority Hall in Madras. The record lists attendance and absences, confirms the previous meeting’s minutes, reviews party organisation in several states, approves an ad hoc committee in Uttar Pradesh, and discusses correspondence concerning the party’s reorganisation. It also records plans to build a democratic opposition front, pursue common candidates, renew party membership, postpone internal elections until after the 1976 general elections, and appoint S. V. Raju as a joint secretary subject to General Council approval.\n\nThe appended resolutions place the party firmly in opposition to the Emergency and to the ruling Congress’s handling of Jayaprakash Narayan’s People’s Struggle. They support Morarji Desai’s fast and demand restoration of normal political conditions and elections in Gujarat; condemn the obstruction of J. P. Narayan’s address in Calcutta; criticise the method by which Sheikh Abdullah was placed in power in Kashmir and oppose the continuation of Article 370; and advocate cooperation among democratic, non-Congress, non-communist parties. The final resolutions defend a mixed economy against what the minutes describe as an emerging totalitarian economy, criticise controls, shortages, black money, and industrial financial distress, and oppose low procurement prices and compulsory levies that disadvantage farmers.",

      "Internal party elections were deferred until after the 1976 general elections, while state units were urged to renew membership and enrol new members.",

      "The economic resolutions defended the mixed economy and criticised controls, shortages, black money, government policy, and procurement practices that harmed farmers."
